contradicting_evidence: Negative settled ETF flows, contracting stablecoin supply, weak breadth and declining ETH/BTC form a coherent bearish cluster that could persist through the week.
Only about 11.8% of the large-alt proxy advanced over 24h, arguing against assuming a broad recovery is already developing.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Near-term weakness may persist, but the supplied snapshots cannot reliably distinguish continued contraction from stabilization followed by recovery over a full week. A bounce or reduced selling would not by itself establish recovery, and BTC resilience would not establish altcoin transmission.
falsification_conditions: Persistent multi-session price declines accompanied by continued ETF outflows, supply contraction and weak breadth would establish a clearer downside edge.
Durable BTC and ETH recovery accompanied by stronger ETH/BTC, broad outright participation and improved fresh flow evidence would establish a clearer upside edge.
missing_evidence: No week-scale sequence establishes whether price, breadth and flows are improving together or deteriorating persistently.
Fresh ETF sessions, updated liquidity observations and current macro or catalyst developments are unavailable.
Independent confirmation beyond the Top-100 proxy, including the unavailable microcap lane, is absent.
supporting_evidence: Current observations establish weakness but do not demonstrate its persistence over the forecast week.
There is no observed broad recovery sequence, while relative resilience in some mid- and smaller-alt proxies prevents treating weakness as uniform across all capitalization buckets.
The supplied structural prior describes conditional recovery or retest failure, not a verified turning point; it does not resolve the week-ahead outcome.
